Games and Visuals

Indie Games at Muro Studios

I worked as Founder/CEO, Game Artist, Animator, Level Designer and Game Designer at indie team Muro Studios (2015 - 2023). Released games DOOMBLADE, Shadow Bug, Shadow Bug Rush and Bro Fist Simulator.

Grublin Wagon Shop.
8k in-game screenshot from DOOMBLADE.
Visual assets created in Photoshop and Blender. Environment Art made in Unity.
All visuals by me.

Release Trailer of DOOMBLADE. It's available on PC on Steam, Epic Store and GOG.
Check out the 60fps version here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/922050/DOOMBLADE/

Walkthrough of the game can be seen here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J8HB1I8Mdmw

All in-game visuals and animations by me.
I painted everything in Photoshop and modeled all the assets and characters in Blender. I animated everything in Unity.
I also balanced the gameplay feel and economy in the game and worked on the level design.
Code and lead game design by Kim Valori.
Music and sfx by Brian Skeel.
I acted as the Art Director for the release trailer from concept to final version while keeping the game Publisher's marketing team in the feedback loop.
Video editing by Samuli Lautjärvi.
Key Marketing Art in the end of the video by Boris Moncel from TAKEOFF Studios.

Title for Muro Studios game Shadow Bug Rush. (iOS, Google Play).
Featured on the App Store front page.
http://www.shadowbugrush.com
All visuals by me.

Shadow Bug Rush was released half a year after Shadow Bug.
It's a f2p version of the game with collectable characters, power ups and infinite levels. When we were releasing Shadow Bug Rush, we pitched an idea to our Apple contact that it would be amazing if Shadow Bug would get the free app of the week at the same time when we release Shadow Bug Rush so these two games could advertise each other in the games. We got the double feature!

All visuals, animations and video editing by me.
Code and design by Kim Valori.
Music and sfx by Veli Laamanen.
Additional sfx by Denis Zlobin.

iPhone screenshot of a highlight moment:
Shadow Bug and Shadow Bug Rush featured at the same time at the Apple App Store front page!

Shadow Bug was featured on the front page of the App Store when it was released as a premium paid game.

When we released Shadow Bug Rush we managed to get both of the games featured on the front page of the App Store.
Shadow Bug was featured as the free downloadable premium game of the week while both games cross-promoted each other in-game.
